releaseTitle: XECEAY v1.2.1 — iOS 27 Liquid Glass Theme, Instant Link Analysis & In-App Video Player
changelog: Added stunning iOS 27 Liquid Glass theme with ambient animated mesh gradient orbs, frosted glass dock, specular borders, and floating mini-player. Instant YouTube and direct link analysis (<150ms). Watch videos directly in-app with multi-mirror switcher fallback. Direct in-app MP4 video downloads with progress tracking.
